messages.content: What's the average temperature for Los Angeles in December?

function.name: calculate_bmi

message.content:
Los Angeles enjoys a mild winter. In December the city’s average daily temperatures typically hover around:

| Metric | Celsius | Fahrenheit |
|--------|---------|------------|
| Average high | ~20 °C (68 °F) | 68 °F |
| Average low | ~12 °C (54 °F) | 54 °F |
| Daily mean (average of high & low) | ~16 °C (61 °F) | 61 °F |

So you can expect a comfortable, temperate climate—cool but not cold—throughout December.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What's the average temperature for Los Angeles in December?" We need to provide an answer. There's no tool needed. Just give approximate average temperature. According to typical climate data, average high around 20°C (68°F), average low around 12°C (54°F). So average maybe 16°C (61°F). Provide both Celsius and Fahrenheit. Also mention that it's mild.
